description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature with persist.
The persist ability triggers, returning that creature to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
Ivy Lane Denizen and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve Ivy Lane Denizen's trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the persist creature.
Resolve Blasting Station's trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the ability from step 1, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
